description.raw:
'''Active:''' '''Rammus''' rolls into an accelerating ball, [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|channeling]] for up to 6 seconds to gain [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 25% – 40.83% (based on level)[[Category:Debug]] '''bonus total''' movement speed per second over the duration, up to a maximum of 150% – 245% (based on level)[[Category:Debug]].

''Powerball'' can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or upon casting ''[[File:Rammus Defensive Ball Curl.png|20xpx|border|link=Rammus#Defensive Ball Curl|An icon for Rammus's ability Defensive Ball Curl]] [[Rammus#Defensive Ball Curl|Defensive Ball Curl]]''.
description.text:

Powerball can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or upon casting Defensive Ball Curl.

description2.raw: '''Rammus''' stops rolling upon colliding with an enemy, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies and [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocking them back]] 125 units, though not through terrain. Enemies hit are then [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Stun|An icon representing the keyword Stun]] [[:Stun|stunned]] and [[File:Reveal icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Standard sight|An icon representing the keyword Standard sight]] [[:Sight#Standard sight|revealed]] for 0.4 seconds, as well as [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowed]] for 1 second.
description2.text: Rammus stops rolling upon colliding with an enemy, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies and knocking them back 125 units, though not through terrain. Enemies hit are then stunned and revealed for 0.4 seconds, as well as slowed for 1 second.

notes.text:
The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
* If the ability is not manually recasted, the secondary effect will trigger without being considered as an ability activation.
The bonus movement speed stacks multiplicatively with other sources of movement speed boosts.
Powerball will still collide with enemies if Rammus is ghosted.
For the purpose of moving closer to an enemy when right clicking them, Powerball also reduces Rammus'  attack range「 to 0 」「 by 125 」for the duration.
* Regardless of this, during Powerball Rammus will also always attempt to path towards his target's center instead.
Rammus will ignore unit collision for the purpose of pathfinding during Powerball.
* Rammus acts as if he were ghosted for the duration of Powerball.
Powerball is not a movement channel, and so will not be interrupted by root and ground.
Displacement immunity will also resist the application of the stun.
